name: Kazhdoe utro budil'nik menja ubivaet
source:
A short visual novel about anxiety, cyclicity, and trying to wake up when it's too late.

You're not a hero. You're just not sleeping. Because you know: As soon as you close your eyes, it will ring again.

Alarm. Not just a device. He's alive. And he's waiting for you.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4078030/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一部关于焦虑、周期性以及试图在为时已晚时醒来的短篇视觉小说。

你不是英雄。你只是没睡而已。因为你知道：只要你闭上眼睛，它就会再次响起。

警报。不仅仅是一个设备。他还活着。他正在等你。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4078030/]Steam[/url]]
